summary_text:
LEGAL SUMMARY (EVIDENCE-CONSTRAINED):

The case is coming on for final hearing before the Hon'ble District Court, Adilabad on 21.2.2014, in the presence of police, with the accused appearing in person. After perusing the case record, the court issued a Committal Order.

The complaint was filed through the Circle Inspector of Police, Chennur.

The court took cognizance of the case against the accused for offences under Section 147, 148, 302 read with 149 of the Indian Penal Code (IPC), and Section 25(1)(a), 27 of the Indian Evidence Act (IA Act), as per PRC 38 OF 1998.

On 8.9.1998, the case against accused A-1, A-3, A-5, A-6, A-8 was split from PRC 6/1996 and renumbered as PRC 38/1998, and section 82 CrPC proceedings were issued.

On 21.2.2014, accused No.8 was produced before the court on execution of a PT Warrant. The case against the other accused involved in the offence was split from PRC 38/1998 and renumbered as PRC 8/2014. Hence, PRC 38/1998 shall run only against accused No.8.

The Superintendent, Central Prison, Warangal is directed to produce the accused before the Hon'ble District Court, Adilabad on 20.3.2014.

The case records, documents, and articles, if any, shall be submitted to the Court of Sessions, Adilabad forthwith under Section 209© CrPC.

The factum of commitment shall be intimated to the Public Prosecutor under Section 209(d) CrPC.

Section 302 IPC is exclusively triable by the Court of Sessions, Adilabad. Therefore, this case is committed
